name: Incident first look
description: Reads the service's logs, nginx and Docker, has your LLM give the likely cause and a fix, and runs the fix once you allow it.

nodes.command:
journalctl -u {{input.service}} -n 150 --no-pager 2>/dev/null
tail -n 80 /var/log/nginx/error.log 2>/dev/null
docker ps -a 2>/dev/null | head -20
true

nodes.prompt:
These are logs from my servers. In 4 short lines: what is the likely cause of the trouble, and what would fix it?
{{nodes.logs.output}}

From this finding, give the one shell command that fixes it. Reply with only the command, on one line:
{{nodes.cause.text}}

nodes.title: Run this fix on your web servers?
